📌 Governance Snapshots: Why Your Tokens May Not Count in a DAO Vote

Main Points
⏺ Some DAOs calculate voting power using token balances from a specific blockchain block
⏺ Buying tokens after that snapshot may not increase your voting power
⏺ This post explains how balance snapshots work and why purchase timing matters

1️⃣ Core Idea — the protocol records balances at a selected block to determine how many votes each participant receives.
2️⃣ Why It Exists — a fixed reference point prevents voting power from changing every time tokens are transferred during the voting process.
3️⃣ Example — a vote uses balances from block #1000, but you buy tokens at block #1005. Those new tokens won't increase your voting power for that proposal.
4️⃣ Risk Surface — users may buy governance tokens specifically to participate, only to discover the snapshot already happened.
5️⃣ Practical Rule — before buying governance tokens, check the snapshot block, delegation conditions, and voting eligibility rules.

Final Thoughts

DAO governance isn't only about how many tokens you hold. It can also depend on when you held them. Sometimes your voting power is decided before the vote even begins.

⚠️ Tether leads $15M funding for Mural to power AI agent payments 

👀 Tether has led a $15 million Series A funding round for New York-based Mural, supporting the financial technology company’s development of payment infrastructure for businesses and artificial intelligence agents. Mural plans to use the investment to expand internationally and develop the banking, payment and compliance services needed for software agents to conduct financial transactions.

🔔 Founded in 2022 by former Palantir engineers Sinclair Toffa and Chris Fernandes, the company provides infrastructure that businesses use to manage accounts, payment instructions, identity verification and regulatory requirements across banking networks and blockchains. Its customers include global payroll provider Deel, browser developer Opera and financial technology platform Axexo. Through Mural’s system, businesses can offer accounts holding dollars, local currencies and stablecoins without managing separate financial infrastructure for each payment method.

📌 The company reported processing $2.1 billion in payments for users across 128 countries since introducing its application programming interface in 2025. Payment volume recorded so far in 2026 is nearly six times its total for 2025. Mural has not disclosed the valuation attached to the latest funding round. Fortune reported that the company previously raised $5 million in seed financing in 2022, followed by additional capital from existing backers.

Blackout Necessary?

Someone asked was this a move against the Cabal?

It is a move against dependence  and dependence is the Deep State's leverage. A base that needs the civilian grid is a base the grid's owners can brown out. A base that needs a global supply chain is a base that can be strangled by a chokepoint, a shipping lane, a customs hold, a port strike. The 90-day islanding doctrine is the military finally admitting, in writing, that the umbilical cords are enemy terrain.

SO IS IT ANTI-DEEP STATE? Partly. It is anti-capture. 

A military that can run 90 days off-grid cannot be coerced by whoever controls the switch. Whether the switch-holders are foreign or domestic is a distinction the doctrine deliberately blurs and that blur is the tell. They are hardening against both.

It's safe to be ready. 

Why Are The Deep State Panicking?

They are not on their last leg because they are losing elections. They are on their last leg because the machinery that made elections decisive is failing. The midterms are a symptom, not the cause. The cause is that three of their load-bearing pillars are cracking at the same time. The money printer, the media monopoly, and the administrative state's insulation from accountability. When all three wobble together, the rational move is not to wait  it is to strike while the shackles are still on the other guy.

Think About The Implications 

The Federal Reserve is the deepest node. The regional reserve presidents and the Board of Governors are the operational layer. 

The families behind the clearing banks  the Rothschild London clearing house lineage, the Rockefeller Chase lineage, the Warburg/Kuhn Loeb merchant-bank thread  sit above the Fed as the shareholder-of-last-resort class. The printer is their leverage. A dinar revaluation, a debt jubilee, a move off the petrodollar, any of it  all of it runs through their hands first. They are not fighting the reset. They are positioning inside it so they survive it. Watch the Basel and BIS corridors, not the Fed pressers.

That Is Pillar One 

-The Media

-The Administrative State 

We Are Nearing The End Of This System 

These Are The Factions Positioning Themselves 

The Atlanticist banking bloc  London, Basel, Brussels-adjacent. Wants the reset to run through the existing institutions so they keep custody of it.

The Davos/WEF technocratic bloc  Schwab's lineage, the Klaus/Malloch-Brown thread. Wants the reset to run through standards and compliance so they keep the rulebook.

The Silicon Valley sovereign bloc, Thiel, the Andreessen/Horowitz axis. Wants the reset to run through compute and energy so they keep the pipes. This is the bloc most likely to defect from the others, and the others know it.

The sovereign-nationalist bloc  the Trump/White Hat/military-intel axis. Wants the reset to run through state power and tribunals so the others answer for it.
